id: 09_Radiography Safety Officer (RSO) Interview Questions and Answers
title: 安全知识问答：射线探伤与辐射防护（国内版）
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/09_Radiography Safety Officer (RSO) Interview Questions and Answers.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/09_Radiography Safety Officer (RSO) Interview Questions and Answers（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 什么是工业射线探伤（了解）
points.K5: 一年的剂量有没有“安全值”
points.K7: 探伤作业前要核查什么
points.S2: 辐射工作人员：培训、监测、体检

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上亮着问号灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz desk with a glowing question-mark lamp and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识问答，今天讲电离辐射。
overlay: 安全知识问答：射线探伤与辐射防护

shots.scene: 电离辐射标志、剂量计、铅屏蔽三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an ionizing radiation warning sign, a personal dosimeter, and a lead shielding block. No people.
shots.narration: 从工业探伤，说到实验室射线装置。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在X射线衍射仪前，好奇地伸手想开防护门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of an enclosed X-ray diffractometer with a radiation warning sign and reaches for its shielded door.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次见到X射线衍射仪。

shots.scene: 仪器指示灯亮着，阿杰的手停在门把上
shots.prompt_en: The diffractometer's warning lamp glows while the young male student's hand hovers over the door handle.
shots.narration: 灯还亮着，他就想打开门看看。

shots.scene: 小研快步过来，指向警示灯和标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and points at the warning lamp and the radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先看懂这些再说。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the quiz desk and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 射线看不见、摸不着，我们一题题来。

shots.section_title: 什么是工业射线探伤（了解）
shots.scene: 探伤机对着管道焊口的简笔图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a portable radiography device pointed at a welded joint on a large pipe, with a film behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么是工业射线探伤？
overlay: 什么是工业射线探伤（了解）

shots.section_title: 什么是工业射线探伤（了解）
shots.scene: 射线穿过焊缝，底片上显出裂纹和气孔
shots.prompt_en: Rays pass through the weld to a film that shows a dark crack line and small round pores. No people.
shots.narration: 不切不坏，就能看出裂纹和气孔。

shots.section_title: 什么是工业射线探伤（了解）
shots.scene: γ射线源和X射线管两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a sealed gamma source capsule and an X-ray tube. No people.
shots.narration: 用γ射线源或X射线机，查焊口和旧管。

shots.section_title: 什么是工业射线探伤（了解）
shots.scene: 实验室里的X射线衍射仪、荧光光谱仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an enclosed X-ray diffractometer and an X-ray fluorescence analyzer in a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 高校里的射线装置，原理相通。

shots.scene: 三张单位卡片：活度、吸收剂量、有效剂量
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards with icons: a glowing atom, an absorbing block, and a human silhouette. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：辐射用什么单位？

shots.scene: 旧单位卡片被移到一边
shots.prompt_en: Two old blank unit cards slide to the side, marked with a small clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 居里是活度的旧单位，不是剂量。

shots.scene: 人体剪影图标旁的有效剂量卡片高亮
shots.prompt_en: The card with the human silhouette glows. No people.
shots.narration: 说人受了多少照射，用希沃特。

shots.scene: 老李手持巡测仪靠近屏蔽门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a handheld radiation survey meter near the shielded door of the diffractometer.
shots.narration: 第三题：巡测仪测什么？

shots.scene: 巡测仪屏幕空白，旁边波形图标
shots.prompt_en: A survey meter with a blank screen and a small wave icon showing a level reading. No people.
shots.narration: 测周围的辐射水平，就是剂量率。

shots.scene: 老李沿着装置外围逐点测量
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks around the instrument, checking point by point with the survey meter and noting on a blank sheet.
shots.narration: 看屏蔽有没有漏，边界该划在哪。

shots.scene: 小研胸前佩戴个人剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a small personal dosimeter clipped on her lab coat chest.
shots.narration: 第四题：个人剂量计测什么？

shots.scene: 剂量计图标和累加的柱状图
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter icon next to a bar chart that adds up over time. No people.
shots.narration: 测自己身体受到的外照射剂量。

shots.scene: 剂量计在胸前规定位置佩戴的示意图标
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram showing the correct chest position of a dosimeter on a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定位置佩戴，不能借给别人。

shots.section_title: 一年的剂量有没有“安全值”
shots.scene: 一年的日历和一条红色上限线
shots.prompt_en: A yearly calendar icon next to a bar chart with a solid red upper limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：一年受多少照射才安全？
overlay: 一年的剂量有没有“安全值”

shots.section_title: 一年的剂量有没有“安全值”
shots.scene: 写着安全的空白牌子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank sign with a green shield on it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有“安全剂量”，只有不得超过的限值。

shots.section_title: 一年的剂量有没有“安全值”
shots.scene: 空白国家标准文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank national standards booklet with a radiation warning sign on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 限值按国家标准，以现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 一年的剂量有没有“安全值”
shots.scene: 柱子远低于红线，向下的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Bars staying far below the red limit line with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 限值以内，还要尽量再低。

shots.scene: 日历一页页翻，剂量柱慢慢升高
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flipping while a dose bar slowly rises. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：射线探伤有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 人体剪影上出现几个警示点
shots.prompt_en: A human silhouette icon with warning dots on the scalp and inside the body. No people.
shots.narration: 长期受照，可能脱发、致癌。

shots.scene: 手部皮肤红肿的示意和红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A simple hand icon with reddened skin and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 大剂量照射，会灼伤皮肤，甚至致命。

shots.scene: 无关人员走进警戒线、无证人员操作两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a person stepping over a warning barrier, and a person without a badge operating a device. No people.
shots.narration: 无关人员闯入、无证人员操作，都危险。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前要核查什么
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白核查清单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank checklist on a clipboard in front of a radiation work area.
shots.narration: 第七题：开工前，安全员查什么？
overlay: 探伤作业前要核查什么

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前要核查什么
shots.scene: 许可单和风险评估单图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form and a blank risk assessment form, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 作业许可，风险评估。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前要核查什么
shots.scene: 辐射安全许可证和仪表校准证书图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank license certificate with a radiation sign and a blank calibration certificate beside a survey meter, both checked. No people.
shots.narration: 放射源许可证，仪表校准证书。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前要核查什么
shots.scene: 人员资质证书和体检报告图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank qualification card and a blank medical report with a stethoscope icon, both checked. No people.
shots.narration: 人员资质证书，体检报告。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前要核查什么
shots.scene: 衰变表和运输车辆图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank decay chart and a transport vehicle with a radiation sign, both checked. No people.
shots.narration: 衰变表，运输车辆合格。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前要核查什么
shots.scene: 作业区四周围警戒线、警示牌和闪灯
shots.prompt_en: A work area fenced with a barrier tape, radiation warning signs, and flashing warning lights. No people.
shots.narration: 现场围好警戒，挂牌、亮警示灯。

shots.scene: 一条随时间下降的曲线
shots.prompt_en: A curve that falls over time on a blank chart, with a sealed source icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：什么是衰变表？

shots.scene: 曲线上标出今天的位置
shots.prompt_en: A marker on the decay curve labeled with a calendar icon for today. No people.
shots.narration: 放射源的活度，随时间一天天减少。

shots.scene: 老周对照衰变表查看源的台账
shots.prompt_en: The older man compares a blank decay chart with a blank source logbook at his desk.
shots.narration: 查表就知道源现在有多强。

shots.scene: 区域平面图：内圈红色，外圈黄色
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan icon with an inner red zone around a radiation source and an outer yellow zone. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：什么是控制区？

shots.scene: 内圈红区边上的门禁和警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The inner red zone with an access gate and a radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 要采取专门防护措施、严格控制进出。

shots.scene: 外圈黄区里有检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: The outer yellow zone with a survey meter icon checking it. No people.
shots.narration: 外圈是监督区，要定期监测。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，旁边一张写着随便工作的卡片被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head beside a blank card crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 控制区不是谁都能进去干活的地方。

shots.scene: 巡测仪在警戒线外测量
shots.prompt_en: A survey meter icon held at a barrier line, with a wave icon fading outward. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：剂量率和警戒边界。

shots.scene: 离源越远，波纹越淡
shots.prompt_en: Concentric ripples from a source icon becoming fainter with distance. No people.
shots.narration: 边界按测量结果和标准来划。

shots.scene: 公众小人图标在警戒线外
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms representing the public standing outside the barrier line. No people.
shots.narration: 公众要求比工作人员更严。

shots.scene: 胶片剂量计盒的简笔图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a film badge holder with a clip. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：胶片剂量计。

shots.scene: 剂量计按周期送检，日历和快递盒图标
shots.prompt_en: A film badge icon going into an envelope next to a calendar with a cycle arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 戴满一个周期，送去测读累计剂量。

shots.scene: 空白的个人剂量档案夹
shots.prompt_en: A blank personal dose record folder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 结果要存进个人剂量档案。

shots.scene: 三个原子图标，原子核大小不同
shots.prompt_en: Three simple atom icons with the same number of protons but nuclei of different sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：同位素为什么有危险？

shots.scene: 一个原子核稳定，一个原子核向外发射射线
shots.prompt_en: One atom icon calm and stable, another atom icon emitting rays outward. No people.
shots.narration: 有的稳定，有的会放出射线。

shots.scene: 射线打在细胞图标上
shots.prompt_en: Rays hitting a simple cell icon, with a small crack in its center. No people.
shots.narration: 射线会损伤人体组织，可能致癌。

shots.scene: 铅罐和上锁的贮源柜
shots.prompt_en: A lead container and a locked source storage cabinet with a radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性物质，要锁好、看好。

shots.scene: 辐射安全许可证图标挂在墙上
shots.prompt_en: A blank license certificate framed on a lab wall next to a radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 用放射源和射线装置，先取得许可证。

shots.scene: 老周在空白台账上登记源和装置
shots.prompt_en: The older man records entries in a blank logbook next to a locked source cabinet and an X-ray instrument.
shots.narration: 源和装置一一登记，建好台账。

shots.scene: 私自购买、转借放射源的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a source container being handed over a counter, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得私自购买、转让、转借。

shots.section_title: 辐射工作人员：培训、监测、体检
shots.scene: 王老师给学生上辐射安全培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches the young male student and the female graduate student in front of a blank screen with a radiation sign.
shots.narration: 辐射工作人员，先培训、考核合格。
overlay: 辐射工作人员：培训、监测、体检

shots.section_title: 辐射工作人员：培训、监测、体检
shots.scene: 小研佩戴剂量计，剂量计图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that her personal dosimeter is clipped on before entering the instrument room.
shots.narration: 工作时佩戴个人剂量计。

shots.section_title: 辐射工作人员：培训、监测、体检
shots.scene: 体检图标和日历
shots.prompt_en: A stethoscope icon next to a calendar with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 上岗前、在岗期间、离岗时都要体检。

shots.scene: 时钟、尺子、铅板三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a stopwatch, a measuring tape, and a lead shielding wall. No people.
shots.narration: 防外照射，记住三件法宝。

shots.scene: 秒表转得飞快，小人快速完成操作
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon with a person pictogram finishing a task quickly and stepping away. No people.
shots.narration: 能少待一会，就少待一会。

shots.scene: 小人离源越来越远，射线越来越淡
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram stepping back from a source while the rays fade with distance. No people.
shots.narration: 能离远一点，就离远一点。

shots.scene: 铅屏蔽挡在源和人之间
shots.prompt_en: A lead shielding block placed between a source icon and a person pictogram, rays stopped by it. No people.
shots.narration: 该有的屏蔽，一块也不能少。

shots.scene: 仪器门上的电离辐射标志和亮着的警示灯
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation warning sign and a glowing warning lamp on the shielded door of an X-ray instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 见到这个标志和亮灯，别靠近。

shots.scene: 防护门打开，射线自动切断的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the shielded door opening and the X-ray tube symbol switching off automatically. No people.
shots.narration: 门一开，射线自动停，这叫联锁。

shots.scene: 联锁开关被胶带短接，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an interlock switch taped over to bypass it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁短接、拆除联锁装置。

shots.scene: 阿杰点点头，退后一步等小研关机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and steps back as the female graduate student switches off the diffractometer before opening the door.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：关机灯灭，才能开门。

shots.scene: 探伤机源卡在导管里的示意，红色警示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a source stuck in a guide tube with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 源卡住收不回，或者源丢了怎么办？

shots.scene: 小人沿箭头撤离，现场拉起警戒
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms walking away along an arrow while a barrier tape is set up around the area. No people.
shots.narration: 人员撤离，隔离现场，不要乱碰。

shots.scene: 老周打电话报告，保卫处值班员赶来
shots.prompt_en: The older man makes an urgent phone call as the security officer arrives at the barrier.
shots.narration: 立即报告单位和主管部门。

shots.scene: 不明金属小物件被人捡起，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand picking up an unknown small metal capsule from the ground, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 捡到可疑金属物，别拿，马上报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现电离辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 射线看不见，靠仪表测、靠制度管。

shots.scene: 巡测仪和个人剂量计图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a survey meter and a personal dosimeter. No people.
shots.narration: 巡测仪测环境，剂量计测自己。

shots.scene: 红线上限和向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: A red upper limit line with bars far below it and a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 没有安全剂量，限值内尽量低。

shots.scene: 许可证、培训、体检三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank license, a classroom board, and a stethoscope. No people.
shots.narration: 持证使用，培训考核，定期体检。

shots.scene: 时钟、尺子、铅板、联锁门图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stopwatch, a measuring tape, a lead wall, and an interlocked door. No people.
shots.narration: 时间、距离、屏蔽，联锁不能短接。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台后挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye from behind the quiz desk with the question-mark lamp.
shots.narration: 灯亮不开门，下期再见！
